RULES_BODY:
Three players, 17 cards each, 3 bottom cards.
Bidding: in turn bid 1-3 above the current bid or pass; a bid of 3 wins at once; if nobody bids the cards are redealt.
The landlord takes the bottom cards and leads; the two farmers team up. Follow with the same type and size, higher; bombs beat any non-rocket play and the rocket beats everything. When both others pass, the last player to play leads freely.
Combinations: single, pair, triple, triple + 1, triple + pair, straight (5+), pair chain (3+ pairs), airplane (optionally with as many singles or pairs), four + two, four + two pairs, bomb, rocket. Chains never include 2 or jokers.
Scoring: bid × multiplier; every bomb or rocket doubles; spring (farmers never play) or reverse spring (landlord played once) doubles. The landlord wins or loses double; scores always sum to zero.
